verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail offers lease-grade addresses from the same provider: TruLease includes a commercial lease agreement, a physical address and an optional utility bill. It also offers residency-grade addresses through TruResidence, and a registered agent service is included free with mailbox plans. For LLC formation, however, the evidence shows only TruStart's self-paced videos and pre-filled registered-agent templates, not a done-for-you formation filing service. Missing for 10: an actual LLC formation or filing service, explicit support for foreign qualification filings, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of the bundled offering.
